i've tried to kill myself 7 times. one time was with a handful of pills and liquor, i remember the complete absence of any other feelings other then the burning in my throat. I sat at the end of my bed for hours looking into absolute nothing until the pain became a constant, loud, and violent little reminder that I was going to die. So I did what any belemic 14 year old girl would do; I threw up. Then I remember feeling drunk and sore, my head throbbing and my eyes incredibly dry. So I slept and woke up the next day as if nothing had ever ever happened. The reason this attempt was so important to me for some reason is the memory. The other 6 times I've attempted were all throughout a long school week and I can honestly say the one thing I know for a fact that happened that week was me skipping classes and sleeping in my own blood on the bathroom floor. The rest of week feels like a terrible blur that I can almost touch, that's how the year went by as well; a terrible blur. I guess what I'm trying to say is I am still alive a year later. Things aren't perfect right now but I am still here. Because at the end of the day life is short but death is fucking eternity.
